title: Be Yesu ling
stanzas: Be Yesu ling` ka chunya otur, Kuom dwaro mor kata wer;Saa ma ting` tura parruok be ola, ka wuoth bedo maolo chuny?
Be Yesu ling` ka chunya opong` kod buok be luoro mathoth;Kodiechieng` rumo kotieno chopo, bende obedo machiegni?
Be Yesu ling` saa ma tem matek asekedogo motama;Ka chunya kuyo hoch be ongena, kata pi wang`a chwer malit?
Be Yesu ling` ka tho pogoa gosiepna mahero chuth;Ka chunya kuyo kachiegni gi tho, be oling` ma ok onena?
chorus: Ee, orita mano adier; Kuyona mulo chunye;Ka aol godiechieng`, Kaluor gotieno, adier Jawar rita (adier).
